auth.label: Client Secret
auth.description: Xweather API client secret passed as the client_secret query parameter. Register an application in the Xweather Apps section to get the access ID and secret key: https://www.xweather.com/docs/weather-api/getting-started

extraFields.label: Client ID
extraFields.description: Xweather API access ID passed as the client_id query parameter. Register an application in the Xweather Apps section to get the access ID and secret key: https://www.xweather.com/docs/weather-api/getting-started

actions.name: get_forecast
actions.description: Retrieve Xweather forecast periods for a location.

location.description: The Xweather location identifier, such as a city name, postal code, station ID, or latitude and longitude pair.

filter.description: The Xweather forecast filter, such as day, daynight, 1hr, or 3hr.

limit.description: The maximum number of records to return.

periodLimit.description: The maximum number of forecast periods to return.

items.description: One Xweather field path such as place.name or ob.tempC.

fields.description: The Xweather dot-notation fields to include in the response.

inputSchema.description: The input payload for retrieving an Xweather forecast.

loc.description: A raw nested object returned by Xweather.

anyOf.description: The forecast interval returned by Xweather.

interval.description: The forecast interval returned by Xweather.

place.description: A raw nested object returned by Xweather.

items.description: A raw nested object returned by Xweather.

periods.description: The forecast periods returned by Xweather.

forecasts.description: The forecast records returned by Xweather.

outputSchema.description: The response returned when retrieving an Xweather forecast.

actions.name: get_observation
actions.description: Retrieve the latest Xweather observation for a location.

location.description: The Xweather location identifier, such as a city name, postal code, station ID, or latitude and longitude pair.

items.description: One Xweather field path such as place.name or ob.tempC.

fields.description: The Xweather dot-notation fields to include in the response.

inputSchema.description: The input payload for retrieving an Xweather observation.

anyOf.description: The reporting station ID returned by Xweather.

id.description: The reporting station ID returned by Xweather.

anyOf.description: The observation data source returned by Xweather.

dataSource.description: The observation data source returned by Xweather.

loc.description: A raw nested object returned by Xweather.

place.description: A raw nested object returned by Xweather.

profile.description: A raw nested object returned by Xweather.

observation.description: A raw nested object returned by Xweather.

outputSchema.description: The response returned when retrieving an Xweather observation.

actions.name: get_place
actions.description: Resolve an Xweather place by location identifier.

location.description: The Xweather location identifier, such as a city name, postal code, station ID, or latitude and longitude pair.

items.description: One Xweather field path such as place.name or ob.tempC.

fields.description: The Xweather dot-notation fields to include in the response.

inputSchema.description: The input payload for resolving an Xweather place.

loc.description: A raw nested object returned by Xweather.

place.description: A raw nested object returned by Xweather.

profile.description: A raw nested object returned by Xweather.

outputSchema.description: The response returned when resolving an Xweather place.
